strings.zh: 口袋竞技是{NEWLINE}与３只精灵一起{CLEAR}参加３场比赛的体育盛典。{SCROLL}口袋竞技的赛事设有搭配{SCROLL}精灵个性的各种比赛。{SCROLL}请一定要带着３只精灵{NEWLINE}来参加口袋竞技啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Pokéathlon is a sports festival in{NEWLINE}which you and three Pokémon compete in{CLEAR}three events.{SCROLL}The Pokéathlon has a variety of events{NEWLINE}to accommodate different aspects{CLEAR}of Pokémon.{SCROLL}Please come join us with three Pokémon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 全明星杯是{NEWLINE}由各地区精选{SCROLL}出来口袋竞技员{NEWLINE}参加的特殊赛事。{SCROLL}在全明星杯拿到冠军的话{SCROLL}就能得到比平常更多的点数。{SCROLL}请一定要试试挑战{NEWLINE}那些精英精灵们啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Supreme Cup is a special course{NEWLINE}only for the top Pokéathletes{CLEAR}from all over the world.{SCROLL}You will earn more points than usual{NEWLINE}when you win a Supreme Cup!{SCROLL}Please, challenge the{NEWLINE}top Pokéathletes!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 速度竞技{NEWLINE}是由３个以{CLEAR}速度为主的赛事{CLEAR}组成的。{SCROLL}跨越障碍冲向第一吧！{NEWLINE}「跨栏」{SCROLL}快速收集旗子吧！{NEWLINE}「抢旗」{SCROLL}讲究３只精灵间的配合！{NEWLINE}「赛跑」{SCROLL}拿到冠军就能得到{NEWLINE}速度奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着有自信的{NEWLINE}３只敏捷的精灵{CLEAR}来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Speed Course consists of three{NEWLINE}events that require good{CLEAR}Speed Performance.{SCROLL}“Hurdle Dash”{NEWLINE}Jump over the Hurdles to be{CLEAR}number one!{SCROLL}“Pennant Capture”{NEWLINE}Capture Pennants quickly!{SCROLL}“Relay Run”{NEWLINE}Show your teamwork!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Speed Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good Speed{NEWLINE}for these events.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 力量竞技{NEWLINE}是由３个以{CLEAR}力量为主的赛事{CLEAR}组成的。{SCROLL}将结在一起的石板击碎吧！{NEWLINE}「劈石板」{SCROLL}推进圈里吧！{NEWLINE}「抢位置」{SCROLL}不断狂踢形成射门吧！{NEWLINE}「足球」{SCROLL}拿到冠军就能得到{NEWLINE}力量奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着有自信的{NEWLINE}３只强壮的精灵{CLEAR}来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Power Course consists of three{NEWLINE}events that require good{CLEAR}Power Performance.{SCROLL}“Block Smash”{NEWLINE}Smash all the Blocks!{SCROLL}“Circle Push”{NEWLINE}Push them out while you stay in!{SCROLL}“Goal Roll”{NEWLINE}Drive them out and roll the balls{CLEAR}toward the Goal!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Power Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good Power{NEWLINE}for these events.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 耐力竞技{NEWLINE}是由３个以{CLEAR}耐力为主的赛事{CLEAR}组成的。{SCROLL}将对手挤出圈外吧！{NEWLINE}「撞人」{SCROLL}３只精灵的体力是关键！{NEWLINE}「赛跑」{SCROLL}在体力耗尽前不断破坏吧！{NEWLINE}「劈石板」{SCROLL}拿到冠军就能得到{NEWLINE}耐力奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着有自信的{NEWLINE}３只持久的精灵{CLEAR}来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Stamina Course consists of three{NEWLINE}events that require good{CLEAR}Stamina Performance.{SCROLL}“Ring Drop”{NEWLINE}Blow them away and stay on the Ring!{SCROLL}“Relay Run”{NEWLINE}The Stamina of all three is key!{SCROLL}“Block Smash”{CLEAR}Smash away as long as your{NEWLINE}Stamina holds!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Stamina Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good Stamina{NEWLINE}for these events.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 跳跃竞技{NEWLINE}是由３个以{CLEAR}弹跳力为主的赛事{CLEAR}组成的。{SCROLL}用跳床朝着天空跳吧！{NEWLINE}「蹦床」{SCROLL}跳着接住飞碟！{NEWLINE}「抢飞碟」{SCROLL}用跳跃华丽地躲开栏吧！{NEWLINE}「跨栏」{SCROLL}拿到冠军就能得到{NEWLINE}跳跃奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着有自信的{NEWLINE}３只好弹跳的精灵{CLEAR}来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Jump Course consists of three{NEWLINE}events that require good{CLEAR}Jump Performance.{SCROLL}“Lamp Jump”{NEWLINE}Jump to the sky and hit Lamps!{SCROLL}“Disc Catch”{NEWLINE}Jump and catch flying Discs!{SCROLL}“Hurdle Dash”{NEWLINE}Jump over the Hurdles cleanly!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Jump Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good Jump{NEWLINE}for these events.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 技巧竞技{NEWLINE}是由３个以{CLEAR}技术为主的赛事{CLEAR}组成的。{SCROLL}精准地扔雪球吧！{NEWLINE}「扔雪球」{SCROLL}目标明天,漂亮射门！{NEWLINE}「足球」{SCROLL}快速切换抢旗子吧！{NEWLINE}「抢旗」{SCROLL}拿到冠军就能得到{NEWLINE}技巧奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着有自信的{NEWLINE}３只技巧的精灵{CLEAR}来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Skill Course consists of three{NEWLINE}events that require good{CLEAR}Technique Performance.{SCROLL}“Snow Throw”{NEWLINE}Aim for them and throw Snow!{SCROLL}“Goal Roll”{NEWLINE}Roll the balls into the Goal!{SCROLL}“Pennant Capture”{NEWLINE}Switch quickly and grab Pennants!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Skill Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good Skill{NEWLINE}for these events.{SCROLL}

This is the reception for the{NEWLINE}Link Pokéathlon.{SCROLL}Oh, my!{NEWLINE}Is this your first time?{SCROLL}Then please ask at the single-player{NEWLINE}reception first.{SCROLL}If you go to the right from here, it’s{NEWLINE}the middle counter.{SCROLL}You can get an explanation of the{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon there, so I recommend{CLEAR}going there first.

strings.zh: 通信口袋竞技时{NEWLINE}带着３只精灵{CLEAR}参加４项比赛角逐的{CLEAR}体育盛事。{SCROLL}另外还能跟朋友在{NEWLINE}同一系列赛事中竞争。{SCROLL}口袋竞技的赛事{NEWLINE}设有配合{SCROLL}精灵个性的各种比赛。{SCROLL}请一定要和朋友一起来参加{CLEAR}通信口袋竞技啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Link Pokéathlon is a sport festival{NEWLINE}in which you join with three of your{CLEAR}Pokémon to compete in four events.{SCROLL}Your friends can join the same events{NEWLINE}to compete.{SCROLL}The Pokéathlon has a variety of events{NEWLINE}to accommodate many of the different{CLEAR}aspects of Pokémon.{SCROLL}Please bring your friends to the{NEWLINE}Link Pokéathlon.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 速度＆跳跃竞技{NEWLINE}是由结合了速度与弹跳力的{CLEAR}４场赛事{CLEAR}所组成的。{SCROLL}跨越障碍争取第一把！{NEWLINE}「跨栏」{SCROLL}迅速拿到亮光的灯吧！{NEWLINE}「蹦床」{SCROLL}迅速接飞碟吧！{NEWLINE}「抢飞碟」{SCROLL}专注于速度！{NEWLINE}「赛跑」{SCROLL}拿到冠军就能得到{NEWLINE}速度奖章和跳跃奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着对速度与{NEWLINE}弹跳力有自信的３只精灵{CLEAR}和朋友们一起来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Speed & Jump Course consists of{NEWLINE}four events that require good{CLEAR}Speed and Jump Performance.{SCROLL}“Hurdle Dash”{NEWLINE}Jump over the Hurdles to be{CLEAR}number one!{SCROLL}“Lamp Jump”{NEWLINE}Take the Lamps quickly!{SCROLL}“Disc Catch”{NEWLINE}Catch the Discs rapidly!{SCROLL}“Relay Run”{NEWLINE}Superb Speed is highly required!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Speed Medal and the Jump Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good{NEWLINE}Speed and Jump for these events, and{CLEAR}bring your friends as well.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 跳跃＆技巧竞技{NEWLINE}是由结合了弹跳力与技术的{CLEAR}４场赛事{CLEAR}所组成的。{SCROLL}灵巧地跳跃触碰灯吧！{NEWLINE}「蹦床」{SCROLL}跳着接飞碟吧！{NEWLINE}「抢飞碟」{SCROLL}灵巧地移动拿旗子吧！{NEWLINE}「抢旗」{SCROLL}瞄准对手扔吧！{NEWLINE}「扔雪球」{SCROLL}拿到冠军后就能得到{NEWLINE}技巧奖章与跳跃奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着对弹跳力与{NEWLINE}技巧有自信的３只精灵{CLEAR}和朋友们一起来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Jump & Skill Course consists of{NEWLINE}four events that require good{CLEAR}Jump and Skill Performance.{SCROLL}“Lamp Jump”{NEWLINE}Show your skill in jumping to{CLEAR}touch the Lamps!{SCROLL}“Disc Catch”{NEWLINE}Jump and catch the Discs!{SCROLL}“Pennant Capture”{NEWLINE}Show your moves and collect Pennants!{SCROLL}“Snow Throw”{NEWLINE}Aim with accuracy!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Jump Medal and the Skill Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good{NEWLINE}Jump and Skill for these events, and{CLEAR}bring your friends as well.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 技术＆力量竞技{NEWLINE}是由结合了技术和力量的{CLEAR}４场赛事{CLEAR}所组成的。{SCROLL}目标明天,漂亮射门！{NEWLINE}「足球」{SCROLL}瞄准目标扔吧！　{NEWLINE}「扔雪球」{SCROLL}灵巧地移动拿旗子吧！{NEWLINE}「抢旗」{SCROLL}击碎石板吧！{NEWLINE}「劈石板」{SCROLL}拿到冠军后就能得到{NEWLINE}技巧奖章与力量奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着对技巧与{NEWLINE}力量有自信的３只精灵{CLEAR}和朋友们一起来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Skill & Power Course consists of{NEWLINE}four events that require good{CLEAR}Skill and Power Performance.{SCROLL}“Goal Roll”{NEWLINE}Aim at the Goal and shoot!{SCROLL}“Snow Throw”{NEWLINE}Steady, aim, and fire away!{SCROLL}“Pennant Capture”{NEWLINE}Show your moves and collect Pennants!{SCROLL}“Block Smash”{NEWLINE}Blocks keep coming! Smash them all!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Skill Medal and the Power Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good{NEWLINE}Skill and Power for these events, and{CLEAR}bring your friends as well.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 力量＆耐力竞技{NEWLINE}是由结合了力量与耐力的{CLEAR}４场赛事{CLEAR}所组成的。{SCROLL}击碎石板吧！{NEWLINE}「劈石板」{SCROLL}将对手推出圈外吧！{NEWLINE}「抢位置」{SCROLL}一直射到精疲力尽吧！{NEWLINE}「足球」{SCROLL}将对手击出圈外！{NEWLINE}「撞人」{SCROLL}拿到冠军后就能得到{NEWLINE}耐力奖章与力量奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着对力量与{NEWLINE}耐力有自信的３只精灵{CLEAR}和朋友们一起来参加啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Power & Stamina Course consists{NEWLINE}of four events that require good{CLEAR}Power and Stamina Performance.{SCROLL}“Block Smash”{NEWLINE}Blocks keep coming! Smash them all!{SCROLL}“Circle Push”{NEWLINE}Push them away and stay in the Circle!{SCROLL}“Goal Roll”{NEWLINE}Keep rolling until your energy{CLEAR}runs out!{SCROLL}“Ring Drop”{NEWLINE}Drop them off the Ring and stay on top!{SCROLL}When you win, you will be awarded{NEWLINE}the Power Medal and the Stamina Medal.{SCROLL}Choose three Pokémon with good{NEWLINE}Power and Stamina for these events,{CLEAR}and bring your friends as well.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 耐力＆速度竞技{NEWLINE}是由结合了耐力与速度的{CLEAR}４场赛事{CLEAR}所组成的。{SCROLL}重视耐力与速度的{NEWLINE}「赛跑」{SCROLL}将对手击出圈外！{NEWLINE}「撞人」{SCROLL}跨越障碍目标第一！{NEWLINE}「跨栏」{SCROLL}强推对手进入圈内！{NEWLINE}「抢位置」{SCROLL}拿到冠军后就能得到{NEWLINE}耐力奖章与速度奖章。{SCROLL}请一定要带着对耐力与{NEWLINE}速度有自信的３只精灵{CLEAR}和朋友们一起来参加啊。{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 大师竞技{NEWLINE}是每次都是不同{CLEAR}比赛的超难赛事。{SCROLL}必须要选择无论{NEWLINE}什么比赛都能克服的{CLEAR}万能型队伍！{SCROLL}大师竞技{NEWLINE}无法得到奖牌,{SCROLL}但是得到的竞技点数{NEWLINE}会是两倍！{SCROLL}请和朋友一起{NEWLINE}来挑战吧！{SCROLL}
